info.title: Voice Studio API
info.description: Workspace-scoped agent APIs. Dashboard access uses short-lived JWT cookies, rotating refresh cookies and CSRF protection. Server integrations use scoped X-API-Key credentials. Public widgets use origin-bound session capabilities.

403.description: Signed-in owner/admin and valid CSRF required

409.description: Trial already used elsewhere, or capacity unavailable

202.description: Enquiry received by the durable outbox; not a confirmation of SMTP delivery.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh UUID v4, reused for retries of the same enquiry.

StartPhoneTrial.title: StartPhoneTrial
StartPhoneTrial.description: No choices: the server binds the person, workspace, pool and number.

WidgetCapability.description: Origin-bound capability returned by a public widget session

WidgetResumeCapability.description: Origin-bound seven-day resume token returned by a public widget session; never a dashboard credential
